test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which government official announced the Ladli Behna Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ladli Behna Yojana** was officially announced by the then **Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh**, **Shivraj Singh Chouhan**, on **January 28, 2023**.
 
• The announcement was made during the celebration of **Narmada Jayanti** in the **Narmadapuram** (formerly known as **Hoshangabad**) district of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The primary objective of the scheme is to enhance the **economic independence** of women in the state, improve their **health and nutritional status**, and grant them a greater say in **family-level decision-making**.
 
• Initially, the scheme promised a monthly financial assistance of **Rs. 1,000** to every eligible woman, which was later enhanced to **Rs. 1,250 per month**.
 
• The scheme targets women from **economically weaker sections**, **middle-class families**, and **deprived categories**, aiming to provide them with a safety net for their daily personal expenses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eligibility Criteria**: To benefit from the **Ladli Behna Yojana**, the applicant must be a **permanent resident** of **Madhya Pradesh**. The **age** limit for the beneficiaries was originally set between **23 and 60 years**, but was later revised to include women aged **21 to 60 years**.
 
• **Economic Limitations**: The scheme is restricted to families whose total **annual income** is less than **Rs. 2.5 lakh**. Additionally, the family members should not be **Income Tax payers**.
 
• **Land Ownership Rule**: A critical feature of the eligibility is that the family of the beneficiary should not own more than **5 acres** of **agricultural land**.
 
• **Exclusion Factors**: Women who are already receiving a monthly amount of **Rs. 1,250** or more from other **Government of India** or **State Government** social security or pension schemes are not eligible to apply.
 
• **Historical Context**: This scheme is often seen as an extension of the **Ladli Laxmi Yojana**, which was also a flagship program of the **Madhya Pradesh** government focused on the welfare of **girl children**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Implementation and Disbursement**: The funds are transferred directly into the **Aadhaar-linked bank accounts** of the beneficiaries through the **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** system on the **10th day** of every **month**.
 
• **Budgetary Allocation**: The **Madhya Pradesh government** allocated a substantial budget of approximately **Rs. 8,000 crore** for the first financial year to ensure the smooth rollout of the scheme across the state.
 
• **Application Process**: The registration was made accessible by setting up special **camps** at the **Gram Panchayat**, **Ward**, and **Anganwadi** levels to assist women with the **e-KYC** and application filing.
 
• **Scale of Impact**: It is estimated that more than **1.25 crore** women in **Madhya Pradesh** have been enrolled under this scheme, making it one of the largest **cash-transfer programs** for women in **India**.
 
• **Documentation Required**: Key documents required for the application include the **Samagra ID**, **Aadhaar Card**, **Mobile Number**, and a **bank account** that is enabled for **DBT**.
